newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm. Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 21,800 slaughter steers and 11,300 heifers; 93,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,000 head formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 100 head or 2 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00-64.25, mostly 64.00. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs
Wk to Date - 93,300 Week Ago - 93,400 Year Ago - 56,500
